programs.title: Miffy and Friends
programs.desc: Miffy can't wait to spend the last day of summer at the beach with her friends and family. But Mother Nature has other plans, and before she can build the biggest sandcastle ever, it starts raining.

programs.title: The Woohoos!
programs.desc: When Scotty can't find the treasure he hid, the Woohoos spot a squirrel, digging for - they assume - its own treasure.

programs.title: Nikhil & Jay
programs.sub_title: Nikhil and Jay and the Kitten Mission
programs.desc: Nikhil and Jay notice Max the cat is very hungry and sleepy - she must be about to have kittens! They prepare all the things kittens need, but realise kittens will be hard work!

programs.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
programs.desc: Daniel is excited to play at the playground, but first they need to go to the store to get new shoes for Margaret. It can be very hard to wait, but Daniel learns to sing and imagine to pass the time.

programs.title: Mittens & Pants
programs.desc: Pants is very excited for his Aunt Chiffon to visit. He has a whole tour of Kibble Corners planned. But when she has to stay inside because of allergies, he takes the tour digital.

programs.title: BeddyByes
programs.desc: MeMo wants to paint a picture but is frustrated when the Tweeties accidentally mess it up. BaBa encourages all their friends to add to the picture and helps MeMo to see its beauty.

programs.title: Mixmups
programs.desc: The MixMups mix up a 'Happy Hat' adventure to find a hat that will cheer up Giggle. But when Giggle keeps the hat to herself, it soon loses it magic. Will Giggle find another way to bring happiness back to the hat?

programs.title: Ready Eddie Go!
programs.desc: Trying broccoli as a new food can be challenging. Eddie learns how to overcome this by seeing, smelling, touching and finally - trying.

programs.title: Bluey
programs.desc: Bluey needs Mum's advice on dealing with a troublesome neighbour, when the serenity of her couch cushion playhouse is threatened by Bingo's growing stable of animals.

programs.title: Fizzy And Suds
programs.desc: Did someone say pizza? Yes please! Fizzy and Suds find out how to make this delicious food and join a pizza party!

programs.title: The Makery
programs.desc: After a scare from the Makery Tree, Nim sets to work making a spooky tree picture. She also bakes a pretzel spider web and creates a spooky top for one of the Crafty Kids.

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: It's Express Yourself with Art Day! After some 'Hot Potato' fun, Lucia encourages The Wiggles to draw their feelings. Afterwards Lucia shares the idea of displaying their drawings in The Wiggly Art Gallery.
